protocol.temporal_alignment: independent uniform sampling of 16 frames over each generated and ground-truth clip
protocol.spatial_alignment: each sampled RGB frame resized to 224x224
protocol.fvd: SignViP repository StyleGAN-V I3D TorchScript features
protocol.fid: SignViP repository ImageNet Inception-v3 pool3 features
protocol.clip_fid: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 projected image embeddings (unnormalized)
protocol.noncomparability_reason: full 642-video test split and explicit local alignment; the paper does not release complete preprocessing/evaluator details

identity_similarity.reason: The paper's identity detector/embedding protocol and checkpoint are unavailable.

hand_ssim.reason: The paper's hand detector/cropping protocol and checkpoint are unavailable.

comet.reason: CorrNet+ predicts glosses, not spoken-language translations required by COMET.
